title: CERC RE Tariff Regulations & Solar Resource Assessment Benchmarks
description: Normative and empirical capacity utilization factors (CUF %) for utility-scale solar PV parks across Indian states.

Karnataka.basis: Pavagada Ultra Mega Solar Park benchmark (2,050 MW high-DNI plateau)

Andhra Pradesh.basis: Kurnool / Ananthapuramu Ultra Mega Solar Park empirical benchmark

Telangana.basis: Deccan plateau state normative benchmark (CERC Southern Region zone)

Tamil Nadu.basis: Kamuthi / TNERC normative utility-scale solar benchmark

Maharashtra.basis: Western Maharashtra / Sakri Solar Park regional benchmark

Uttar Pradesh.basis: Bundelkhand regional solar park proxy (moderate DNI, winter haze impact)

West Bengal.basis: Gangetic delta regional proxy (lower DNI, higher monsoon cloud attenuation)

Gujarat.basis: Charanka Solar Park & Coastal Saurashtra / Kutch high-irradiance benchmark
